column1: # Engine wave W5 (18 Oct 2026, rulings R136–R138): the regional safe default for Latin America and the Caribbean
# (`default.safe.americas`, Generic.kt; spec §6.2 c), gated for the first time, as a stress test only: no table
# is held for any country it serves, so it is checked against the nearest real tables, eight ISNA-method mosque
# calendars of the United States (us.isna's own rows; the US is never routed here), chosen for a spread from
# Houston and Southern California to Georgia, Virginia and New York, each at its mosque's own point. Every row
# is held out. What the rows show is the cost of the region's design (its late limits, Generic.kt,
# americasLateLimits): Isha 15 to 30 min after the mosques' 15° one (this region's is the 18° + 2 min in use
# further south), the end of eating 15 to 30 min before their 15° Fajr (the 18° dawn − 2 min), Fajr up to 6 min
# after their 15° one, and the floors plus the cushion on the rest (sunrise up to 7 min before, Dhuhr up to 6
# after, Maghrib up to 7, Asr up to 5).
# One cell is masked, a limit of the fallback for the owner (BUILD-LOG, W5), not an exception added quietly:
# - Islamic Center of Irving: Dhuhr is not checked. It prints a Dhuhr later than this region's floor (the 1986
#   + 2 min with the cushion, 5 min after the transit) on 7 days of 2026, by a minute: a mosque's own rounding
#   of its + 5 against a floor the spec sets. Widening the region's floor is a §6.2 c change, so it goes to the
#   owner; the US is never served by this region (it has us.isna, which holds this table without exception).
# Ushuaia (ruling R247, 13 Nov 2026; the audit's finding F18): the Moonsighting Committee's own 2026 table for Ushuaia
# (54.8° S, archive/tables/manual/mcw/2026-10-11/ushuaia-2026.txt), which the safe defaults lane measured on 12 Nov and
# left out, is held now, with the Committee's tables for sixteen more points and years of the band, in
# safe-default-americas-promise.tsv: to the promise alone, because they are a calculator's tables that no community
# there is known to follow, so their lateness is not this region's figure and they are no rows of this file. The early
# Fajr they showed (243 of 365 days at Ushuaia, up to 96 min) is closed in the engine, not excused: from 43.5° of
# latitude the region's day takes the Committee's day at the place's own point beside it (Generic.americasAt). The
# rows below are all north of the band and read as before.
